name: simulate-funding-candidate-evaluation-boundary
why: Measured reach for the pure annual candidate capital-loss, tax, ACA, HSA-cap, penalty, and required-need evaluation extracted behind the funding fixed point. The full corpus exercises non-ACA and actionable/non-actionable ACA years, subsidized and gross-premium probes, capital-loss netting, traditional/Roth/HSA character, cap-dependent HSA refresh, tax/penalty assembly, and all four equivalence modes. Direct contract tests pin the independently recomputable Form 8606/capital-loss/penalty worksheet, the two-pass HSA-cap worksheet, plan-derived tax-exempt-interest pricing, a forced gross basin, caller-input purity, and exact withdrawal-plan identity. The hostile delegation test injects impossible evaluation values and proves simulatePlan consumes the coordinator result instead of locally rebuilding it.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. Corpus-cold known-attestation merge, contradicted-attestation provenance, and HSA-only recharacterization are intentionally excluded from steady-state ranges and pinned by direct contract tests. The defensive nonconvergent HSA-cap fallback is unreachable while its frozen finite qualified-expense cap is the sole refresh input, so neither this corpus nor direct tests claim it. Object identity and hostile output consumption are delegation-test responsibilities, not claims made by a byte-identical dump or coverage range. EXCLUSIONS (2026-09-30): every whole line this spec leaves out of its ranges because no plan that parses can execute it is named, with the reason and whatever direct test pins it, in the note of the entry it was cut from; the pieces that continue that entry carry its id with a numeric suffix. The blocks corpus reaches every other line of every range.
